name: Acceptance test 14 - Allow with NotResource (complement scope, excluded ARN never shown as granted)
note: IAM-704 complement handling. An Allow of s3:GetObject scoped with NotResource grants the action on EVERY resource EXCEPT the listed one - a broad read. The engine models the granted action (s3:GetObject) but must NEVER treat the NotResource ARN (arn:aws:s3:::audit-archive/*) as the granted resource: the resources array is emptied and the carve-out rides in a separate excludedResources field. Complement scope is approximate, so policy-evidence is reduced a notch. Analysis is NOT blocked (valid identity policy).
